_meta.doc: Canonical U.S. GDP sectors covering all NAICS 2-digit sectors. Sector keys are stable IDs used as foreign keys from companies/<id>/company.toml (`gdp_sector`) and from taxonomy/occupations_soc.json. NAICS codes are the 2-digit sector groupings; gdp_share_pct is the rounded 2025 share of U.S. value added.
_meta.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, GDP by Industry, Table TVA110; GDPVal (OpenAI, 2025); BLS SOC.
_meta.source_table: TVA110 — Value added by Industry as a Percentage of Gross Domestic Product
_meta.source_release: GDP (Third Estimate), Industries, Corporate Profits, State GDP, and State Personal Income, 4th Quarter and Year 2025, April 9, 2026
_meta.share_units: percent of GDP, rounded to one decimal place

sectors.name: Finance and Insurance
sectors.description: Banking, lending, securities, insurance carriers and brokers; intermediation of capital and risk.

sectors.name: Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
sectors.description: Legal, accounting, engineering, design, consulting, R&D, computer systems services.

sectors.name: Manufacturing
sectors.description: Transformation of materials into goods; durable and non-durable production.

sectors.name: Health Care and Social Assistance
sectors.description: Ambulatory care, hospitals, nursing/residential care, social assistance.

sectors.name: Information
sectors.description: Publishing, software, telecom, data processing, media production.

sectors.name: Wholesale Trade
sectors.description: Distribution of goods to retailers, businesses, and institutions.

sectors.name: Retail Trade
sectors.description: Sale of goods to final consumers; merchandising and store/e-commerce operations.

sectors.name: Real Estate and Rental and Leasing
sectors.description: Real-estate transactions, leasing, property management, rental services.

sectors.name: Government
sectors.description: Federal, state, and local public administration and services.

sectors.name: Administrative and Support Services
sectors.description: Office administration, employment services, facilities, call centers, business support.

sectors.name: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing, and Hunting
sectors.description: Crop and animal production, forestry, fishing, and hunting operations and supply chains.

sectors.name: Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction

sectors.name: Utilities

sectors.name: Construction
sectors.description: Building, heavy and civil engineering, specialty trade, and construction project delivery.

sectors.name: Transportation and Warehousing
sectors.description: Movement of passengers and freight and storage and distribution of goods.

sectors.name: Management of Companies and Enterprises
sectors.description: Headquarters and holding-company activities that direct and coordinate affiliated enterprises.

sectors.name: Educational Services
sectors.description: Instruction and training delivered by schools, colleges, universities, and other providers.

sectors.name: Arts, Entertainment, and Recreation
sectors.description: Performing arts, spectator sports, museums, amusement, recreation, and creative production.

sectors.name: Accommodation and Food Services
sectors.description: Hotels, lodging, restaurants, caterers, bars, and other food-service operations.

sectors.name: Other Services (Except Government)
sectors.description: Repair, maintenance, personal, laundry, nonprofit, and other services outside the major industry groups.
